verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning platform that stores customer PII, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only says that Alloy stores event data (alloy-docs-3) and supports entity merging and ID assignment (alloy-docs-24). Neither is a user-controlled retention policy or a deletion capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
